verdict: NOT QUALIFIED; 18/30 FROZEN CHECKS PASS, 12 FAIL (2 OF THEM NOT EVALUABLE). All failures are preserved; nothing in the template was weakened. The native observer never became READY: its stderr reports 'PTY/keymap/focus/SSD/frame readiness deadline'. The supervisor's 85 s liveness check therefore ended the run before any live export, and cleanup removed both windows before the host capture. W1, W2, W7 and W8 pass. The SSD client itself configured server-side and painted 154 frames. The cause of the observer's readiness failure is NOT established. TW1 (focus race) stays an unconfirmed candidate.
method: Frozen scratch qualifier qualify_two_window.py a4e32678 (30 checks, staged before capture, controls on live001 and desktop002). A missing prerequisite counts as failed.

failed_preserved.W3_dl18_chain_ordered: BEGIN L685 < ENUM rc=0 L757 < ENDPOINT_WAIT missing_checks=0 L760 < DL16 gate L763-L802 (result=0) < IDENTITY rc=0 L805 < SERVER_SOCKET L836 < SSD_PID 14 L838 < OBSERVER_PID 15 L840. The required DL18_TWO_WINDOW_LIVE_RECORDS line is absent.
failed_preserved.W3_observer_ready: There is no DL12_NATIVE_STARTUP_READY line. L922 is the observer's error 'darwin-wayland-terminal-native-startup: PTY/keymap/focus/SSD/frame readiness deadline' (main.rs:669-671; 20 s).
failed_preserved.W3_no_done_or_error_before_capture: Fails on that observer error line. No DL10_CLIENT_DONE or observer DONE line exists.
failed_preserved.W6_four_prefix_records: Live export never ran; decode_records gives 'Incomplete export'. W6_records_stable_rx_nonempty and W6_child_records could not be evaluated, so they count as failed.
failed_preserved.W4_terminal_body_exact, W4_ssd_paint_exa: At host capture the compositor had already closed: framebuffer close L1165 and 'IOGOP: console-return acquire-request result=0x00000000' L1166. The saved framebuffer (9da1329986ea354a, matching the JSON) shows only the returned text console (that line and '#'). Neither window is present.
failed_preserved.W5_outside_only_desktop_and_cursor: Fails, but it is not meaningful without window frames. The console background was taken as the 'desktop' color, and console text counted as other pixels.

observed_facts.ssd_client: DL10_SSD_CONFIGURED <n> mode=server_side serial=1 at L846, before frame 1 at L848, then contiguous DL10_CLIENT_FRAME 1..154. At ≥500 ms per paint that is consistent with running until the supervisor's 85 s teardown. No SSD error line.
observed_facts.termination_path: There is no DL18 FAILED or NOT_READY line, because the script's 85 s 'kill -0 "$observer"' failed under set -e (the observer had exited). The EXIT trap then reaped the SSD client and compositor. STATUS/RETURN/END never printed (live tail, as expected).
observed_facts.controller: result.json DARWIN_COMMAND_LINE_OBSERVED_LINUX_VERIFIED, linux_verified true, reset_attempts 1, diagnostics_complete true (14); returned boot_id is new. The attestation after-native-two-window001-controller-free.json reports Linux verified, 1 reset, no extra reset, latch absent, lock acquired and released.

cause_analysis.established: The observer missed its 20 s readiness deadline, which requires PTY, keymap, current focus with no held keys, SSD configured and a visible PTY frame together (main.rs:745-756).
cause_analysis.not_established: Which gate failed. The observer's own records were never exported, there is no frame showing either window, and the observer prints no per-gate state.
cause_analysis.evidence_on_tw1: The SSD client's acked configure serial is 1, the first value of the compositor's global serial counter, so its surface was configured before the observer's. Configure order is not map order, and focus follows map (wm-core focus_client on map). So this weighs against, but does not exclude, 'SSD mapped last and took focus'. Other gates (decoration negotiation for the second client, frame-callback visibility, held keys) are equally unexcluded.
cause_analysis.next_evidence_suggestion: Not a criteria change: a future supervisor or observer revision could export the observer's per-gate readiness state (PTY, keymap, focused, held, SSD, visible frame) and its configure serial on the failure path, and print an explicit DL18 liveness-failure marker before exiting, so the cause is recorded rather than inferred.

not_claimed: the cause of the observer failure
scope: Read-only: saved capture, frozen scratch qualifier, glyph reader, controller attestation. No hardware, SSH or edits.
